summary.text: Seth Woodall is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Gavin McGaughey; he advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Woodall was born in North Carolina, attended community college, earned a degree from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro and then attended law school.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2023, his responses said he lives in Eden with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children, and that he has grown a law practice and other businesses.

Woodall's survey responses list securing the borders, increasing law enforcement funding, combating inflation, reducing regulations, raising teacher pay and parental choice in education as priorities.
They name law and order, education, election integrity and the economy as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
